description: Experimental Spotify Android original-order playback probe. Adds a manual ContextPlayer/Play test that sends a playlist's tracks in their original order (restarts the playlist if accepted). Unlike SetOptions, this does not directly toggle Shuffle. Free accounts may still reject Play. Existing ad patches unaffected; no Desktop spoof. Spotify 9.1.80.2221 ARM64 APKM only. Not device-tested. Source: https://github.com/NasiGoRank/morphe-spicetify-patches/tree/experiment/ordered-playback-probe
